run_docstring_helpfulness_evaluation: run the docstring helpfulness evaluation on sampled components using an LLM model
sample_docstring_components: sample code components where all systems have valid docstrings for evaluation
evaluate_single_component: evaluate docstrings from all systems for a given component across summary, description, and parameters
calculate_evaluation_statistics: calculate average scores by system, aspect, and system-aspect combination from evaluation results
format_evaluation_markdown: format docstring helpfulness evaluation statistics as a markdown report with tables
